checklist.detail: Stainless Steel (304/316): computed wall temp 1119 K EXCEEDS its 1100 K max service temp (Tc 3465 K, regenerative cooling). Marginal/unsuitable as designed. Basis: coupled throat wall balance: gas h_g ~17.4 kW/m2K, T_aw ~3330 K, coolant ~362 m/s (coolant-side wall ~638 K), 0.20 mm wall. Levers that lower it: faster coolant (Coolant velocity; SP-8087 caps liquids at ~61 m/s, at a jacket-dP cost), a thinner wall, a liner rated hotter or more conductive (e.g. GRCop-84), or more film cooling.

checklist.detail: Hottest wall station is in the convergent section (area ratio ~1.0, regen): wall ~1130 K, 0.97x that section's material limit (warns below 1.15x, like the throat row). Levers: more chamber film (or a convergent film ring for the throat region), faster coolant, a thinner or more conductive liner, or extend active cooling.

checklist.detail: Resultant injection beta angle +4.7 deg is outside the -4 to +2 deg band LOX/LH2 prefers - it wants a slightly negative beta (~0 or below). Adjust the impingement angle or element momentum ratio.
checklist.name: Injector resultant beta angle

checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~2062 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.15 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.
checklist.name: Combustion acoustic-mode margin

checklist.detail: At the throat, combined hoop + thermal-restraint stress (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) is ~1169 MPa (hoop ~41 MPa from a ~3.2 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential + thermal-restraint ~1128 MPa) against a ~67 MPa allowable (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5), with the wall at its minimum-stress thickness ~0.20 mm. This uses a real handbook stress formula (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall), not a proxy - worth a closer structural look. The thermal-restraint term dominates and grows with wall thickness (dT = q*t/k), so the wall is already at its ~0.2 mm minimum - consider a higher-conductivity liner (a copper alloy such as GRCop-84/NARloy-Z) or less throat heat flux (film cooling, lower Pc).
checklist.name: Jacket overpressure vs. channel-wall structural margin
